# Vendored style guide

From chattedomestique/styleguide, branch `claude/generic-style-guide`, commit `e38263e` (v0.2.0).
Copied by `scripts/sync-styleguide.mjs`. Do not edit these files by hand.

Elements: button, card, toolbar, segmented, tabs, slider, appbar, chip, swatch, dialog, spinner, switch, divider, field, input, select.
Scripts (in public/sg/js): core, 42-chip, 44-segmented, 70-scrubber, 71-toolbar.

Archivo is SIL OFL 1.1 (fonts/OFL-Archivo.txt). Icons are Lucide, ISC (LICENSE-lucide.txt).
